reason: CVE-2026-59890 affects source-distribution publishing with Unicode-normalizing filesystems. This Linux model server does not build or publish sdists; that operation is absent from its request path. vLLM 0.32.0 requires setuptools <81 on Python 3.12, so installing 83 would break its declared requirements. Review again if the runtime or its build responsibilities change.

The path escape needs Windows: a drive-qualified absolute path in a wheel's namespace_packages.txt makes os.path.join discard the egg directory during setuptools' legacy install_as_egg path. This model server is a Linux image and installs no wheels at runtime. vLLM 0.32.0 requires setuptools <81 on Python 3.12, so the fixed 84.1.0 would break its declared requirements. Review again if the runtime or its build responsibilities change.

CVE-2026-114603 is reached through TraceState.from_header when a W3C propagator extracts an inbound tracestate header. In vLLM 0.32.0 that extraction (vllm/tracing/otel.py extract_trace_context) runs only when --otlp-traces-endpoint is set; build_vllm_command never passes it or --tool-server and accepts no extra arguments, and no ASGI OpenTelemetry instrumentation is installed or registered. LMCache 0.5.6, the latest release in the base image, requires opentelemetry-api<=1.40.0, so the fixed 1.45.1 would break its declared requirements. Review again if tracing is enabled or LMCache allows a fixed release.
